workflow: Check official Pokemon sources before accepting any fan Mega sprite.
For verified official forms, prefer an existing DS-style conversion that accurately matches the official design.
If the archive conversion does not match the official design closely enough, replace/rework it against official reference art.
Only fully custom Mercury forms remain eligible for original redesign work.
